manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows vertical motion of a thrown ball side-by-side with its velocity-time graph, illustrating that acceleration remains constant at -g even when velocity reaches zero at the top.
manifest.description: Left, a vertical height ruler tracks the ball's position along with live arrows for velocity and constant downward acceleration. Right, a velocity-time graph plots v = u - gt, emphasizing that the slope remains -g throughout the flight.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
